items.briefing:
A US-based service has been found selling over 153 million driver's licence records, and the FBI is investigating. While this focuses on US data, Australians with any US exposure should be alert to phishing attempts using personal details. Separately, ransomware groups are increasingly recruiting insiders — employees who are approached to help attackers gain access — so staff should report any suspicious contact, including unexpected messages offering money or incentives.

New AI risk management guidance has been published locally by the Actuaries Institute and UTS, relevant to Australian financial services organisations navigating AI adoption responsibly.

**Practical tip:** If anyone contacts you unexpectedly asking for system access or offering payment for company information, report it to your manager or IT team immediately — don't engage.
